quote: Christophe now covers the west coast and is the right person to contact. However, this deal doesn't fit our target investment mandates right now.
action: Pass on mandate, but he corrected the coverage: Christophe now has the west coast. Update the list entry even though this deal is dead there.

quote: We are more focused on affordable properties so don't think this is a great fit for us but let us know if there are any other deals we should look at in future.
action: Affordable mandate. Explicitly invited future deal flow.

quote: This is a pass for us. We have deemphasized resi currently in our active fund.
action: Current fund is out of residential. A later vintage fund may not be.

quote: We only do deals in Florida
action: Hard geographic screen. Remove from any California list.

quote: This one isn't for us. Thanks for sending and the follow up.
action: No reason given.

quote: This isn't a fit for us, we are focused on QOZ 2.0 investments currently.
action: Opportunity-zone mandate. Canyon Woods is not a QOZ asset.

quote: We do not have a presence in CA, so this one is a pass for us.
action: No California platform. Geographic, not economic.

quote: We're more focused on our preferred equity/structured finance strategy and are also targeting properties that are newer vintage. With that said, if you would be interested in exploring how we could add some accretive, passive capital that is approved to pair with both Freddie and Fannie to your capital stack we would be happy to discuss. Please let us know your availability for a call over this week.
action: Passes on common equity for vintage, then offers something better than a pass: passive capital pre-approved to sit alongside Freddie and Fannie debt. Asked for availability this week — answer with times. Seventh firm offering capital in a non-common form.

quote: Are you at the FL ICSC conference? I believe that Chris is attending.
action: Not a deal answer — he changed the subject to the Florida ICSC conference. Answer the conference question; the deal ask is still unanswered.

quote: We are going to pass on this one. We have two opportunities we are pursuing right now and need to focus time/capital there in near term. Please keep us in the loop.
action: Capacity, not conviction — two live deals ahead of this one. Asked to stay on the list.

quote: As noted when we spoke, the vintage and geography of this one would not be a fit for us.
action: Both screens at once, and he had already told you on a call. Do not re-pitch this asset here.

quote: We can get on a call, but won't be until Thursday or Friday. Would that work for you?
action: Offered Thursday or Friday. Pick one and send the invite.

quote: Sorry, been out of the country. Vintage will be too old.
action: Straight vintage screen. Sixth firm to name 1986 as the reason.

quote: Not active in CA.
action: Three words, geographic. Keep for anything outside California.

quote: We don't invest in JV Equity deals; we focus on first mortgage lending.
action: First-mortgage lender, not an equity partner. Reclassify out of the JV equity list.

quote: We don't invest in California so this will be a pass for us. Also Mike N is no longer at Loci. Please remove from distribution list.
action: California screen plus a removal request, and Mike Nauman has left the firm. Suppress both addresses and drop Nauman from the list.

quote: We are not a player in California
action: Read it within the hour he promised and passed on California. Closed cleanly — the Stage 2 wave got him to look, and the answer was still no.

quote: Copying Richie who oversees our resi business
action: The CEO routed it internally to Richie DeBeikes, who runs their residential business. Reply on the thread — this is the warmest kind of hand-off.

quote: San Ramon isn't a market of interest for our partners, so we'll pass on this opportunity. That said, we'd be happy to look at any other multifamily.
action: Submarket screen, not sector. Explicitly open to other multifamily.

quote: This is a pass for us, thanks.
action: No reason given, straight off the Stage 2 call request.

quote: Thanks no interest from ourside
action: Passed in six words with no reason attached. Answered from Tamim against a list entry of adel@, so the family-office roster has the wrong contact for the firm.

quote: This isn't of interest
action: Passed within twenty minutes of the family office follow-up landing. Answered from the cc'd partner rather than Annette Madison, the list contact.

quote: This is not a fit for us. We don't invest in multifamily.
action: Does not invest in multifamily at all — a list-fit problem, not a deal problem.

quote: Unfortunately this is not a sector we are looking for new investments in.
action: The CEO answered rather than the list contact. Not allocating to the sector at present.

quote: We are currently not deploying capital into any new real estate investments. Not sure when we will lift that restriction.
action: A full stop on new real estate, with no date on when it lifts. Not worth re-approaching on the next deal without checking first.

quote: Our investment activities in RE are primarily focussed on Canada.
action: Canada-focused. Geography, not the deal.

quote: This is outside of our geographic concentration area.
action: Geography.

quote: Please remove me
action: Removal request from the CIO — she was a cc, not the list contact. Suppress her address; Dennis Goetz did not answer either way.

quote: This is not a fit for us; please remove us from your distribution list.
action: Pass plus a removal request covering the firm, not just him — the send had nine cc's at Highgate, so suppress the whole block.

quote: This is not a fit for us. Good luck with the aquisiton.
action: Clean pass, no reason given.

quote: Unfortunately this investment opportunity is out of scope for our strategy.
action: Out of strategy.

quote: We do not evaluate unsolicited inbound deals.
action: Policy against unsolicited inbound — no amount of follow-up changes this one. Note the list has derrick@ but he replies from derrick.hunter@.

quote: We are full on CRE and focusing on internal deals.
action: Allocation is full and attention is on their own pipeline.

quote: I don't think we've met. Can you send us some information on your firm?
action: The President is asking about ZMR itself, not the deal — he wants a firm background before he looks at Canyon Woods. Send the firm overview alongside the LP deck.

quote: We are developers we are not LP or CoGP capital
action: Not a capital provider at all — they build. A list-fit error rather than a decision on the deal.

quote: Sorry how's Tuesday afternoon around 3pm?
action: Silent through the original and both Stage 1 follow-ups, then answered the Stage 2 call-ask by proposing a time himself — Tuesday 1 Sep at 3pm. That is TODAY, the day Zamir is out. Confirm or hand to Michael Regan now; nobody has replied.

quote: After reviewing the information, we have decided not to pursue the investment.
action: Reviewed and declined off the family office follow-up. Polite, no reason given.

quote: We are currently not offering our clients any investment opportunities in real estate outside Spain.
action: Spain-only mandate for their clients. Geography, and a firm one.

quote: The $31MM equity check is too large for our current target check size so pass for us.
action: Passed on size, not on the deal — he read it properly and described the business plan back accurately. Their current appetite is $3-5M unlevered strategic investments and they have no active mandate. Twentieth check-size pass; too small even for a syndicated slice.

quote: We are really focused on 90s and newer, and tend to shy away from CA. Looking forward to reviewing the next deal.
action: Both screens at once — 1980s vintage and California. Seventh firm to name the vintage. Left the door open for the next deal.

quote: We don't currently have any clients who are looking for JV partners to pursue value add multifamily.
action: An advisory firm, not a principal — they place capital for clients and none is looking for value-add MF JV right now. A list-fit issue.

quote: Too small thanks
action: Two words, sixty seconds after the follow-up landed. $31M is below their floor.

quote: This deal is unfortunately not going to be a fit for us. Thanks for the look.
action: Clean pass, no reason given.
